name: Blinn-Phong Shading Model
aliases: Blinn-Phong Local Illumination for Volume Rendering
definition: Computes specular reflectance using the Blinn-Phong approximation with a cosine-power lobe.
summary: The Blinn-Phong Shading Model is a local illumination technique that calculates specular highlights using a half-vector approximation, avoiding explicit reflection vector calculations to reduce computational cost while maintaining visual plausibility.
